peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Dr. R.E. Hungate pioneered the development of Pre-Reduced Anaerobically Sterilized (PRAS) media, which are processed in a reduced condition and remain reduced up to and after inoculation. 1 The PRAS biochemical system is considered the standard method for Level III identification of anaerobic bacteria.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the CDC formulation of anaerobic blood agar?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Anaerobic Blood Agar (CDC) base contains peptones that supply nitrogenous substances and amino acids necessary for the growth of anaerobic bacteria. Yeast extract provides B-complex vitamins and serves as a growth enhancer. Hemin, vitamin K and sheep blood stimulate the growth of anaerobes.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the medium for anaerobes?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Anaerobic Thioglycollate Medium is used for the cultivation of anaerobes as described by Caselitz and Freitag (1). Anaerobes, which are very particular in regard to the nutrient quality of the substrate, grow very well in this medium.
